human_review_guidance: You are deciding on the recommendation, not publishing. Approve only when every critical and high check passed. Use "correct" to send the Worker and Reviewer back once with a note, "partial" to accept some steps, and "reject" when the release should not be published. Publish separately from the Data Platform release review page if you approve.

inputs.name: dataset_id
inputs.title: Dataset ID (optional, narrows the release queue)

objective: Recommend whether one candidate dataset release is ready for an operator to publish, using its record count, quality results, provenance and accepted predecessor. Do not publish anything.
planner_guidance: Inspect the requested release first: its status, record count, content hash, quality summary and accepted predecessor. Then read the release queue for context on other releases of the same dataset. Plan only read-only steps; never plan a publication, retry or any other write.

reviewer_checks.recommendation: Check the release ID and run the review again.

reviewer_checks.description: The inspected release is the one requested.
reviewer_checks.recommendation: Investigate why a different release was returned before deciding.

reviewer_checks.description: The release is a candidate or awaiting review, so publication is still a decision to make.
reviewer_checks.recommendation: Only review releases in candidate or awaiting_review status.

reviewer_checks.description: The release contains at least one record.
reviewer_checks.recommendation: Re-run the acquisition; an empty release must not replace accepted data.

reviewer_checks.description: The release records a content hash for provenance.
reviewer_checks.recommendation: Rebuild the release so its artifact has a content hash.

reviewer_checks.description: Quality checks were run against the release.
reviewer_checks.recommendation: Run the quality checks before recommending publication.
Fix the source or adapter so the blocking checks pass; do not publish.

reviewer_checks.description: No quality check failed at all.
reviewer_checks.recommendation: Explain each non-blocking failure in the review comment, or accept only part of the review.

reviewer_checks.description: An accepted predecessor exists to compare against.
reviewer_checks.recommendation: For a first release, check the record count against the source's published totals.

steps.purpose: Collect status, record count, content hash, quality results and the accepted predecessor.
steps.title: Inspect the candidate release

steps.purpose: See other releases of the dataset that are candidates or awaiting review.
